d.ko: Live a week in the life of "The POSTAL Dude"; a hapless everyman just trying to check off some chores. Buying milk, returning an overdue library book, getting Gary Coleman's autograph, what could possibly go wrong?

d.zh: 过一周邮差小哥的生活，做倒霉的普通人做的寻常杂事：买牛奶，去图书馆还书，找Gary Coleman要签名，到底哪里出错了呢？
